data.title: Current State Assessment: Multi-Agent Reliability is #1 Gap
data.context:
Live evaluation shows multiAgent at 62% (target 90%) — biggest gap. taskSuccess at 69% (target 80%) is related. Root causes identified:
1. Orchestrator doesn't use ModelRegistry.selectBestModel() — uses llmEngine.call() directly
2. Pipeline stages (pm/architect/developer/qa) use same 120s Promise.race pattern with no model tiering
3. Failed delegations due to weak model assignment (mimo-v2.5-free at 0% reliability)
4. No fallback/retry with alternative model when stage fails
5. Cross-validation invariant check bug: compile-passes check is always-pass due to wrong boolean logic
6. LiveEvaluator CI computation is broken: maps all step results to same aggregate score
data.consequence: Fixing multi-agent reliability will improve both taskSuccess (69%→80%+) and multiAgent (62%→90%+), raising overall score from 76 to ~85+

data.title: Stress Test Bug Fixed + Historical TODOs Resolved
data.context:
The SecondBrain.formatKnowledgeSnapshot() crash in stress test section [12] was caused by accessing `latest.triggers.length` without optional chaining. The `triggers` field was undefined when reflections were stored via StateStore directly (bypassing the SecondBrain.reflect() method). Fixed with optional chaining: `latest.triggers?.length > 0` and `latest.actionItems?.length > 0`. Stress test now runs 10445/10445 pass.

The step-feedback-neg TODO was from a previous session where `deepseek-v4-flash-free` model received negative feedback via the `feedback.recorded` event. The SecondBrain.handleEvent auto-creates a high-priority TODO for negative feedback. This is working as designed — no code fix needed.

The 4 failed delegated tasks (pm-001, dev-003, dev-004, dev-005) were due to the `deepseek-v4-flash-free` model being too weak for the pipeline tasks. The actual work was completed manually — profile endpoint is implemented and all 36 fixture tests pass.
data.consequence: Clean slate for new work. Coverage and all tests pass. The `deepseek-v4-flash-free` model should be avoided for complex delegated tasks. The optional chaining fix makes formatKnowledgeSnapshot resilient to missing optional fields.

data.title: PM: Define GET /api/users/:id/profile endpoint requirements
data.context: Feature Development pipeline run-ses_0d876cb30ffeQDwVTlisCmWX0h-feature-dev. Task: define requirements and acceptance criteria for a new REST API endpoint GET /api/users/:id/profile. Must return: name, email, avatar, bio, joinDate, and stats. Must include auth, error handling, and input validation.
data.alternatives: 1. GraphQL endpoint instead of REST - more flexible but overkill for simple profile retrieval. 2. Return profile as part of GET /api/users/:id - couples profile with user resource. 3. Microservice-based approach - too complex for this feature scope.
data.consequence: Establishes a clean RESTful contract that architect and developer can implement against. Enables parallel work on frontend and backend using the spec as source of truth.
